screening_reference.target: Research screening reference for serious mental illness in source study, not a diagnosis.
screening_reference.population_and_period: 2003 enriched US calibration, weighted for population estimation; worst-month-in-previous12months implementation differs from selected past30days.

referenceProfiles.interpretation_policy: No mild/moderate/severe bands or percentile norms approved. Display continuous0–24 descriptive distress score only pending independent review; any future threshold display must name applicable population, period, language and source.
referenceProfiles.prevalence_warning: Do not estimate SMI prevalence as raw percentage scoring13+ in arbitrary sample; official scoring FAQ warns calibration depends on population characteristics.

references.citation: Kessler RC, Andrews G, Colpe LJ, Hiripi E, Mroczek DK, Normand SLT, Walters EE, Zaslavsky AM. Short screening scales to monitor population prevalences and trends in non-specific psychological distress. Psychological Medicine.2002;32(6):959–976.
references.access_status: 18-page original paper readable from coauthor Daniel Mroczek profile; copyright Cambridge University Press2002. Publicly readable copy, not an established open redistribution license.
references.summary: K6 and K10 were developed for general health surveys using item-response methods. Table2 identifies final six symptoms and30-day frame.

references.role: Required author citation and SMI calibration
references.citation: Kessler RC et al. Screening for serious mental illness in the general population. Archives of General Psychiatry.2003;60(2):184–189.
references.access_status: Publisher full article readable through web; author copy indexed but direct fetch timed out. No article PDF copied.
references.summary: Enriched convenience sample155; reference12-month DSM-IV disorder (excluding substance-use disorder) with GAF<60. Cutoff13+ on0–24 equalized weighted false positives/negatives; sensitivity.36, specificity.96. Critically, NHSDA implementation changed recall to the emotionally worst month within the previous12months. These performance estimates must not be presented as validation of the selected30-day Mandarin form.
